follow-up time: Through the third trimester for the cesarean scar pregnancy group
cohort: 54 pregnant women (27 with cesarean scar pregnancy and 27 controls)
finding: Early pregnancy utero-placental vascular changes in cesarean scar pregnancies, likely due to altered uterine structure and placental proximity to large arteries, may contribute to placenta accreta spectrum and uterine rupture risk, potentially correlating with residual myometrial thickness.
gest_age: First trimester for cesarean scar pregnancy group, 19-22 weeks for control group
